item.title: Bill to ensure minimum wage for farmers advances in House
item.description: Lawmakers will vote on a House bill to extend minimum wage requirements to farm workers in the state, an effort that has been vetoed twice since 2024.

item.title: Close Maduro ally pardoned by Biden once again a target of US criminal investigation
item.description: Alex Saab is under scrutiny again for his involvement in Venezuela's CLAP program.

item.description: In other region/state news, the Christopher Newport baseball team rallied for eight runs in the seventh inning to defeat Eastern Mennonite in its season opener.

item.title: Federal judge dismisses attempt to obtain Michigan voter data in latest rejection of DOJ

item.description: Jacques Leveugle has been under investigation since February 2024.

item.title: Former federal prosecutor who quit amid Trump administration dispute now representing Don Lemon
item.description: Joe Thompson recently formed a law firm with Harry Jacobs, another former prosecutor who quit.

item.title: Proposed bill could offer inmates ‘sense of pride,’ reduced fees
item.description: A Virginia General Assembly House bill that will allow work done while incarcerated to count toward court fines and costs is headed to the Senate, with some bipartisan support.

item.title: 10 dead in shootings at school and home in northeastern British Columbia
item.description: A shooting at a school in British Columbia left eight dead including the suspect, with two more people found dead at a home believed to be connected to the incident, Canadian authorities said Tuesday.

item.title: High school scoreboard: Indian River edges No. 7 Nansemond River in one-point boys basketball upset
item.description: No. 11 Hampton defeated No. 14 Warwick 56-22 in girls basketball, with Khloe Lenard leading all scorers with 25 points for the Crabbers.
